title: Command Palette + Contextual Switchboard: Reorienting Console Navigation for Task-First Workflows
creator: Aisha Kapoor
description:
Problem: As customers add multiple projects, models, and rollout rules, the left rail has become noisy and brittle: feature routes compete for real estate; workspace switching is several clicks deep; and power users want a keyboard-centric way to jump to tasks (create rollout, open cost breakdown, inspect trace) without hunting through deep nav.

Goal: Redesign the console navigation so that both goal-oriented users (ship a rollout, investigate a spike, tune batching) and power users (keyboard-first, multi-workspace) can complete target flows in 1-3 interactions. Deliverables: a) Command Palette (global quick-open with fuzzy search + task shortcuts), b) Contextual Switchboard (workspace-aware, changes visible rail contents), c) Compact Left Rail variant with route grouping and affordances for rollouts & cost views, and d) prototype & testing report for 8 participants.
tasks: Define command set: global actions vs contextual actions
Design keyboard patterns (Cmd/Ctrl+K, Cmd/Ctrl+J for next result)
Map rail groups to user mental models (Projects / Deployments / Monitoring / Settings)
Prototype multi-workspace switcher embedded in command palette
Create compact left-rail wireframes and responsive collapse rules
Run moderated usability test (8 participants) focusing on: create rollout, view cost breakdown, switch workspace, find failed request trace
Synthesize findings and propose metrics for launch (time-to-task, errors, preference)
acceptance_criteria: Command Palette opens with Cmd/Ctrl+K and returns results within 120ms in prototype environment
Users complete 4 core tasks in <= 3 interactions in 75% of moderated sessions
Left rail collapses to a compact icon strip and expands on hover or via keyboard focus
Workspace switcher present in palette and in rail with consistent identity mapping
Design spec approved by PM and Engineering for accessibility (WCAG AA for contrast, keyboard nav for 100% of controls)
updates: 2025-02-14: Kickoff sync with PM/Eng — agreed to scope command palette as primary deliverable for Feb cycle.
2025-02-18: Early sketch review — decided to separate 'task shortcuts' from 'resource search' for faster keyboard scanning.
2025-02-25: Prototype v2 tested with internal engineers; feedback: prioritize fuzzy aliasing for rollout names and allow 'open rollout <id>' syntax.
2025-03-04: v3 adds workspace badges in results and contextual filters (env, model family). Shared Figma to reviewers.
2025-03-07: Accessibility review flagged focus-trap risk in modal; engineering will replace full-screen trap with roving tabindex pattern (ENG-4010).
2025-03-08: Usability test scheduled for 2025-03-12; recruitment in progress (external participants mixed: infra + PMs).
notes: Trade-offs considered: persistent rail vs transient command palette. Chosen: palette for task-first flows + compact rail to preserve discoverability for new users.
Routing implication: search results must encode route params (workspace, project, rollout id) so 'open' action can deep-link. Eng dependency ENG-3982 for route serialisation.
Cost view integration: add 'Show cost breakdown' as a first-class action and pin recent cost queries in palette history for quicker access.
Rollouts UX: include brief preview in result card (traffic split, last change) with hover affordance to jump to audit logs.
Performance requirement: palette keypress latency target <120ms budget; falls back to server-side search for fuzzy matching if client index stale.
